description: Rachael Dowling is running to represent Wisconsin’s 53rd Assembly District and put people before party. Her campaign is focused on affordability, accountability, transparency, affordable housing, responsible government spending, protecting natural resources, and making sure local families have a voice in the decisions that affect their lives.
